name: BACH_0099
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (54%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carries 46%, and both classes fall in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 54%, Invasive 46% | Near tie |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 100th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Split; 3 Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 5, 6, 9) · context · Above 97% and 96% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; favors in situ · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; weak lean away from invasive · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score high; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score high; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The 54% vs 46% margin is narrow, so Invasive may be correct.
- The duct-confinement score (12/20 spot check) overstates in situ growth.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6** — top stroma-invasion region; confirm invasion versus intraductal growth.
2. **Regions 10, 11** — highest per-region invasive risk (96%, 56%); look for invasion.
3. **Regions 5, 6, 9** — tumor-dense; check whether nests stay within duct outlines.
